name: wechat-chat-export
title_zh: 微信聊天记录本地筛选打包，只导出你圈定的那几段
tagline_zh: 不用翻聊天记录翻到眼花。按人、按日期、按附件类型圈选，导出成 AI 能直接读的本地文件。全程离线，授权范围内操作。
tagline_en: Stop scrolling forever. Pick chats, dates, or file types, export locally in AI-ready formats. Fully offline.
desc_en: Locate, inspect, filter, and locally package authorized WeChat for Windows chat history for AI use. Use when a user wants to export selected conversations, dates, or attachment types; do not use to access another person's account or to modify WeChat data.
why_zh: 它先定位微信本机数据库，再让你用筛选器精确切出要的对话切片，而不是整库倒出。打包产物干净、结构清晰。
why_en: It locates the local WeChat DB, then lets you slice out exact conversation ranges via filters—no full-dump mess. Output is clean.
limit_zh: 仅支持 Windows 版微信的本地授权数据；不能读取他人账号，也不能修改原始聊天记录。导出范围限于文字、图片。
limit_en: Windows WeChat only, authorized local data. Cannot access others' accounts or modify originals. Only cached text/images/files export; uncached.
title_en: Local WeChat chat filter & packager for AI use
